$comment: Entry schema for contributes.testProviders (process plugins that declare the workspace.read capability, manifest apiVersion 2). Host validation lives in backend/plugin/contrib_test_providers.go and test_provider_invoke.go. discoverAction must name one of this plugin's contributes.actions with risk 'read'; runAction must name a different action of this plugin (any risk). Each provider is a section of the project sidebar 'Tests' tab. Discovery runs only when the user opens or refreshes the tab: the host calls discoverAction through plugin_host_test_discover with {provider, locale, project: {name, root}} (timeout {{limits.discoverTimeoutMs}} ms) and expects {"tests": [{id, label, path?, line?, children?}]} (<= {{limits.discoverResultMaxBytes}} bytes, <= {{limits.testsMax}} nodes in total, nesting <= {{limits.depthMax}} levels; path is clean and project-relative). Tests run only when the user clicks Run (the first run of a provider whose runAction is not 'read' asks for confirmation): the host calls runAction through plugin_host_test_run with {provider, locale, project: {name, root}, tests: [id]} (<= {{limits.runTestsMax}} ids, an empty list means all tests; payload <= min(action maxPayloadBytes, {{limits.payloadMaxBytes}}) bytes, timeout {{limits.runTimeoutMs}} ms) and expects {"results": [{id, status, message?, durationMs?}], "output"?: string} (status is one of {{lists.statuses}}; <= {{limits.runResultMaxBytes}} bytes; message <= {{limits.messageMaxRunes}} and output <= {{limits.outputMaxRunes}} characters of plain text; invalid or duplicate ids are dropped; ids not in the discovered tree are ignored by the frontend). Optional debugRun (host 0.3.0, contract keySinceHost.debugRun; requires a debuggers entry of this plugin, so also the shell capability) runs and debugs tests as a debug session: the host calls resolveRunAction with {provider, project: {root}, testIds, debug, runId} (timeout {{limits.resolveRunTimeoutMs}} ms, result <= {{limits.resolveRunResultMaxBytes}} bytes, the shape of a debuggers resolveAction result), starts it through the debugger prepare/confirm/start flow (debug false: noDebug) and accepts streamed results for that runId through host.tests.publish ({{limits.publishEventsMax}} events, {{limits.publishMaxBytes}} bytes and {{limits.publishPerSecond}} calls per second at most; event types {{lists.runEventTypes}}; tree kinds {{lists.treeKinds}}; trace, expected, actual <= {{limits.traceMaxBytes}} bytes, output text <= {{limits.outputTextMaxBytes}} bytes; <= {{limits.runNodesMax}} test ids per run) until finished or {{limits.runGraceMs}} ms after the session ended; the plugin is told tests.runEnded {runId} when the session ends.
description: Test providers: discover a project's tests and run them through this plugin's actions, shown in the project sidebar 'Tests' tab.

discoverAction.description: Id of one of this plugin's contributes.actions with risk 'read'.

runAction.description: Id of another of this plugin's contributes.actions; it runs the tests.

debugRun.description: Host 0.3.0 (contract keySinceHost.debugRun): run and debug tests as a debug session of this plugin's debugger with streamed results.

debuggerType.description: Type of one of this plugin's accepted contributes.debuggers entries.

resolveRunAction.description: Id of one of this plugin's contributes.actions with risk 'read' that is not aiCallable and differs from discoverAction and runAction; it returns the debug launch {variables?, request, arguments} of a test run.
